issues.note: Note is muddled, but a real trap (home versus place meant) exists.
Examples are fine; the reversed definition is the real fault.
Medical local means one part only; the definition is reversed.
Duplicates the usage note on the noun local; one fact, one field.
Room-or-building fact stated in three fields.
Four words exceeds the one-to-three-word signpost rule.
Same reversed definition, contradicting the core idea, signpost, and examples.
Date and statistic are barred checkable facts.

findings.F1: Subject-verb agreement error in sense 1 example 'Our children goes'.
findings.F2: Sense 3 definition reversed: says whole body instead of one part.
findings.F3: Sense 2 example contains a checkable date and turnout statistic.
findings.F4: The fact that the noun local is not a room or building is repeated across the usage note, learner error, and false-friends adaptation.
findings.F5: Sense 3 signpost 'part of the body' is four words, over the limit.

missed: Coverage: the common American use of a local train or bus that stops at every station (versus express) is not covered.
